en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
Fixes:
[+] Fixed Unyielding not displaying the original body's death location after returning to a backup body upon death.
[+] Fixed the "night vision" effect of Magic Sense and similar skills not working while shaders were enabled.
[+] Potentially fixed destination-based commission quests failing after the player reached the target location.
[+] Fixed Mortal Cultivation ores failing to generate properly.
New Content:
[+] Added a Reputation Shop with inventory tiers based on reputation rank. It can be opened through dialogue with Yuuki.
[+] Added more Guild Commission quests.
[+] Added custom models for the Spirit Fox race progression.
[+] Added Magic Ore Sense, which evolves from Universal Perception.
[+] Added the Construction Wand mod.
[+] Added the AncientArtifacts mod, featuring Tensura-themed accessories.
[+] Added 8 new Ultimate Skills. See the Quest Book for details.
[+] Added 6 new Unique Skills to the random Unique Skill pool, including skills from TensuraMoreSkills.
[+] Added custom models for the Flügel race progression.
[+] Added 4 new intrinsic and extra skills for the Flügel:
- Eternal Fourth Protection
- Spirit Circuit Overload
- Black Arrow Technique
- Heavenly Shift Technique
[+] Expanded the Quest Book with more skill quests and updated several quest descriptions.
[+] Added Apple Cow?
Adjustments & Optimizations:
[+] Reworked Spirit Summon. All creatures are now supported.
- Summoned creatures can be controlled through Tensura's taming system.
- Summoned creatures can be named, but cannot evolve or use similar progression features.
[+] Reworked Flügel: Tengeki, Far Cry, and Pseudo-Code: Dragon Roar.
[+] Reworked the model, texture, and animations of Flügel's Scythe.
[+] Mechanical Cores can now be found in Dwarven Smithies, Magic Training Grounds, and the Dwarven King's Tower.
[+] The Online Wiki button is now hidden in fullscreen mode.
[+] Adjusted the number of Curios slots.
Removals:
[+] Removed the ore x-ray effect from Magic Sense.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
修复内容：
[+] 修复不屈者在玩家死亡并返回备份身体后，不显示原身体死亡位置的问题。
[+] 修复“魔力感知”等技能的“夜视”效果在开启光影时无法正常生效的问题。
[+] 尝试修复抵达目标地点后委托任务失败的问题。
[+] 修复Tensura凡人修仙附属模组的矿物无法正常生成的问题。
新增内容：
[+] 添加按声望等级划分的声望商店，可通过与优树对话打开。
[+] 添加更多公会委托任务。
[+] 为狐灵种族系列添加专属模型。
[+] 添加新技能“魔矿感知”，由“万能感知”进化而成。
[+] 加入建筑权杖模组。
[+] 加入远古遗物模组，它拥有Tensura主题饰品。
[+] 新增8个究极技能，详细内容请查看任务书。
[+] 新增6个独特技能并加入独特技能随机池，其中包含来自TensuraMoreSkills模组的技能。
[+] 为天翼种系列添加专属模型。
[+] 为天翼种新增4个内在技能与额外技能：
- 久远第四加护
- 精灵回廊过载
- 黑矢术式
- 天移术式
[+] 为任务书添加更多技能任务，并修改部分任务描述。
[+] 添加苹果牛？
调整与优化：
[+] 重做“灵之召唤”技能，目前支持所有生物。
- 召唤生物可通过Tensura驯服系统进行控制。
- 召唤生物可以命名，但无法进化或使用类似的成长机制。
[+] 重做天击、崩哮和伪典·焉龙哮技能。
[+] 重做天翼之镰的模型、材质与动作。
[+] 机械核心现在会出现在矮人铁匠铺、魔法训练所和矮人王塔中。
[+] 全屏模式下不再显示“在线Wiki”按钮。
[+] 调整Curios栏位数量。
移除内容：
[+] 移除“魔力感知”技能的矿物透视效果。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
